summary: ThreadNetwork configures Thread Border Routers and shares Thread credentials between Apple Home devices. It needs an 802.15.4 radio and Apple's credential store, which BifrOSt does not have; Thread is also a Thread Group trademark subject to certification.

features.note: no 802.15.4 radio support in the tree
Wi-Fi credentials are in springboard/src/net/wifi.rs, not Thread

features.apple: Thread Border Router, Thread Leader, End device, Sleepy End device
